reasoning: Board verification first: Ts9d8s — Ts and 8s = two spades, 9d off-suit. Confirmed two-tone with a spade flush draw live, plus open straights (any 6, any J, any Q completes — Q makes hi-end straight QJT, J makes JT9 or J7 holdings hit, 6 makes hero dead to 67). Hero MP has 8h8c = third/bottom set, no spade blocker. Per-villain decomposition of the bet-raise chain: BB donk-lead into four players is structurally a polarised-to-merge construction; range-realistic in a 5-way SRP it skews to T9/77/two-pair, QJs/J7s straights and combo-FD (KsQs/QsJs/Js7s style), with a thin protection-bet frequency from one-pair-with-equity hands (T-with-spade, 9-with-spade). UTG raise OVER a 4-way donk is value-thick — UTG opened 5-handed UTG range, capped at no 4-bets but realised through to a flop-raise into BB's donk plus three live players behind: this is the strongest structural action on the board. UTG's raise range is dominated by straights (QJ, J7s flavoured if in opener range, 67s rarely from UTG), top-two T9, sets TT/99, plus high-equity combo (KsQs, AsQs, AsJs with FD+gutter/straight). CO and BTN behind un-acted matters two ways: (1) RAISE is dead — squeezing OOP w/ third set into a value-thick raiser while two ranges behind get to set-mine / flush-draw-realise against hero's flop-3bet sizing turns set-vs-set / set-vs-straight equity into a stack-off where hero is rarely better than coin-flip and frequently crushed; (2) CO and BTN CALL-overcalls add dead money to a set's value line, improving CALL EV materially. 5-way realisation for middle set is HIGH on this exact street (~52-60% raw equity vs the two declared aggressors' combined range, dropping closer to 45-50% once CO/BTN's draws are weighted in) but turn realisation collapses on Q/J/6/spade rivers — that is a CALL-with-clear-turn-plan, not a stack-it-in-now hand. The RAISE-frequency case is real (protection vs FD + 67/J7 picks, denial of CO/BTN equity) and I won't dismiss it: in solver output I'd expect RAISE 25-35% as a stack-off-or-fold sizing. But the modal action and the architect's lean are aligned — CALL — because pot-control + see-turn + harvest dead money from CO/BTN dominates the EV calculation 5-way. FOLD is not a serious candidate: pot odds 31.5% are met by raw equity even against the value-heavy declared range, and set-mining backside on 8x turn or board-pair turn is non-trivial. Agreement with architect's CALL MEDIUM, with the reservation that the RAISE-mix is genuine and solver may surface it higher than the architect's 30% ceiling — flag for solver verification of the CALL/RAISE split.
